title: Spring Boot 4.0 bootRun fails with NoClassDefFoundError for DataSourceProperties when DevTools is present and the app defines its own DataSource bean
errorSample:
Caused by: java.lang.NoClassDefFoundError: org/springframework/boot/jdbc/autoconfigure/DataSourceProperties
	at org.springframework.boot.devtools.autoconfigure.DevToolsDataSourceAutoConfiguration$DevToolsDataSourceCondition.getMatchOutcome(DevToolsDataSourceAutoConfiguration.java:202) ~[spring-boot-devtools-4.0.8.jar:4.0.8]
	at org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.condition.SpringBootCondition.matches(SpringBootCondition.java:47) ~[spring-boot-autoconfigure-4.0.8.jar:4.0.8]

sources.license: Facts summarized from a public GitHub issue/PR; short error excerpt quoted.

symptom: Running the application with bootRun aborts during context refresh with IllegalStateException 'Could not evaluate condition on DevToolsDataSourceAutoConfiguration', caused by NoClassDefFoundError for org.springframework.boot.jdbc.autoconfigure.DataSourceProperties. The same context starts fine in tests, where DevTools is not loaded.
cause: In Boot 4.0 DataSourceProperties moved into the spring-boot-jdbc module. DevToolsDataSourceCondition references it when exactly one user-defined DataSource bean exists, but spring-boot-jdbc is only an optional dependency of spring-boot-devtools, so the class is missing from a project that does not otherwise depend on JDBC auto-configuration.
fixSummary: Add the missing module to the project dependencies, for example implementation("org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-jdbc") (spring-boot-starter-jdbc also works); removing devtools avoids the condition as well. Fixed upstream in Boot 4.0.9 and 4.1.2.
